sources.title: MemGUI-Agent
sources.snippet: MemGUI-Agent uses ConAct, a Context-as-Action interface that folds action history, updates UI memory, and emits the next GUI action in one structured response.

sources.title: GitHub - lgy0404/MemGUI-Agent
sources.snippet: MemGUI-Agent updates folded history, UI memory, and recent step records while producing the next GUI action. We evaluate both a zero-shot 235B ConAct agent with unchanged backbone weights and MemGUI-8B-SFT, an 8B agent trained on MemGUI-3K.

sources.title: MemGUI-Agent: An End-to-End Long-Horizon Mobile GUI Agent with ...
sources.snippet: Training an 8B model on MemGUI-3K produces MemGUI-8B-SFT, an 8B MemGUI-Agent that achieves the best open-data 8B performance on MemGUI-Bench and generalizes to the out-of-distribution MobileWorld benchmark. Code, data, and trained models will be released at this https URL.
